exposure: Women in the later postpartum period
cohort: Pregnant and postpartum women, and healthy female volunteers
finding: Pregnancy significantly affects the disposition of S- and R-ketorolac, with increased clearance and volume of distribution at steady state observed in women shortly after cesarean delivery compared to the postpartum period and healthy volunteers.
mod_finding: S-ketorolac clearance (analgesia) is even more increased compared to R-ketorolac clearance, and S/R-ketorolac clearance ratio is higher following delivery compared to postpartum period or to healthy female volunteers.
